prompt: Product design concept: a [year, make, model] reimagined as a sofa, with its signature design details (grille, tailfins, headlights, and trim) translated into upholstery and furniture forms, color-matched to the car's original paint. Split-view layout, 9:16 vertical: top third front perspective, bottom two-thirds isometric view, same sofa design, upholstery, and color consistent in both. Centered rule-of-thirds composition, generous negative space. Full-plan solid background matching the car's color exactly, no gradient, studio product lighting. Vintage LUT: warm faded tones, soft film grain, muted saturation, subtle vignette.

promptZh: 产品设计概念：将 [年份, 品牌, 型号] 重新构想为沙发，将其标志性的设计细节（格栅、尾鳍、前大灯和装饰条）转化为软装和家具形态，颜色与汽车的原厂漆面相匹配。分屏布局，9:16 竖屏：上三分之一为正面视角，下三分之二为等轴测视图，两部分的沙发设计、软装和颜色保持一致。采用三分法构图，留白充足。纯色背景与汽车颜色完全一致，无渐变，采用摄影棚产品布光。复古 LUT：暖色调褪色，柔和的胶片颗粒感，低饱和度，微弱的暗角效果。
